title: Average score without the worst one
description: Bug report for the grading helper that averages the scores of a student after dropping the single worst score. Scores are whole numbers from 0 to 100. Three symptoms: when the lowest score occurs several times, all of its copies are dropped instead of just one; a list of only 2 scores is averaged although it is too short; and the average is rounded down although it should be rounded to the nearest whole number. Fix the program. The complete rule is: fewer than 3 scores gives none; otherwise one copy of the lowest score is removed and the result is some(average of the remaining scores), rounded to the nearest whole number with exact halves rounded up.
notes: Three bugs: minimum threshold 2 instead of 3, every copy of the minimum is dropped, floor instead of round-half-up. Visible examples avoid all three. Operands are non-negative, so the half-up formula (2*sum+n)/(2*n) is safe in every language.
